suslicke.title: suslicke.com
suslicke.summary: A developer's personal portfolio with a creative terminal-style interface and command-driven navigation.
suslicke.task: Build a memorable portfolio that stands out from template solutions and loads fast.
suslicke.solution: We built the site on Next.js with a CLI-like interface: command navigation (about, skills, experience, projects, contact) and an interactive hackme challenge.
suslicke.result: A distinctive terminal UX that sticks in memory, with fast-loading pages.

animeenigma.title: AnimeEnigma
animeenigma.summary: An anime streaming platform for watching anime online with a large content library.
animeenigma.task: Launch a streaming service that stays stable under load and serves a large library smoothly.
animeenigma.solution: As part of a team, I helped build the platform on Next.js with PostgreSQL, focusing on the viewing interface and stability under load.
animeenigma.result: Stable performance under load and a large library of available content.

xaid.title: xaid.ai
xaid.summary: An AI-powered HealthTech product that automatically generates ready-to-sign CT reports reviewed by a radiologist.
xaid.task: Build a complex web portal and a powerful admin panel to manage reports, users and the clinical workflow.
xaid.solution: As part of a team, I contributed to the product: a Next.js web portal with a powerful admin panel, DICOM/HL7 integration and an AI layer that generates reports.
xaid.result: An international product with a powerful admin panel through which the team runs reports and the workflow.
xaid.technologies: Web portal, AI, Admin panel, DICOM/HL7

python-guide.title: Python Guide
python-guide.summary: An educational resource for Python job-interview prep: questions and topics.
python-guide.task: Build a handy interview-prep reference that ranks well in search.
python-guide.solution: We built the site on Next.js and MDX with a thoughtful content structure around interview topics and technical SEO.
python-guide.result: Growing organic traffic and stable search rankings.

web-interview.title: Web Interview
web-interview.summary: web.drill — an interview-prep platform for web developers with a regularly growing question base.
web-interview.task: Create an interactive interview-prep platform that's easy to work through and to expand.
web-interview.solution: We built a React interface with a question system, progress tracking and easy navigation.
web-interview.result: High user engagement and a regularly growing question base.

loyrush.title: LoyRush
loyrush.summary: A loyalty and gamification SaaS: points, badges, leaderboards and challenges on a subscription model.
loyrush.task: Build a SaaS that retains clients through gamification and gives them clear analytics.
loyrush.solution: We built the frontend on Vue: loyalty mechanics (points, badges, leaderboards, challenges), a subscription model and a dashboard with analytics for clients.
loyrush.result: A working product with a subscription model and clear analytics for clients.

exchange-bridge.title: Exchange Bridge
exchange-bridge.summary: A fintech comparison service for international money transfers: compare options and save.
exchange-bridge.task: Let users quickly compare ways to send money abroad and pick the cheapest one.
exchange-bridge.solution: We built a comparison service across transfer options — P2P crypto, banks, Wise, Revolut — with real-time rates (150+ currency pairs, refreshed roughly every 30 seconds), hidden-fee detection, risk scoring and a live comparison dashboard.
exchange-bridge.result: Transparent real-time comparison that helps people save on international transfers.

ai-diagnostic.title: AI Diagnostic
ai-diagnostic.summary: An AI medical-imaging assistant for radiologists that helps detect pathologies on CT and MRI.
ai-diagnostic.task: Give radiologists a tool that fits into existing infrastructure without a new system.
ai-diagnostic.solution: As part of a team, I contributed to the assistant: PACS integration with no software install, pathology detection on CT/MRI, and a convenient interface for radiologists.
ai-diagnostic.result: Deployed in Russia and participating in the Moscow Department of Health's computer-vision experiment.

nda-furniture.title: Furniture shop (under NDA)
nda-furniture.summary: An online store selling home furniture. Project details under NDA.
nda-furniture.task: Build a convenient online store for selling home furniture.
nda-furniture.solution: As lead developer I owned the whole store: catalog, product pages, cart and checkout.
nda-furniture.result: A working online store. Its name and details are under NDA.

cost.question: How much does it cost to build a site or app?
cost.answer: The price depends on the task and scope. After a short brief we lock the price and timeline before we start — no hidden add-ons. Landing pages cost less, complex web apps more.

time.question: How long does development take?
time.answer: A landing page — from a few days to a couple of weeks. A web app or SaaS — from several weeks. We give exact timelines after analyzing the task and lock them in our agreement.

support.question: What happens after launch?
support.answer: We stay in touch after launch. Basic support — we keep the site running reliably and available, plus minor fixes. Updates and growth — new features, redesigns, scaling — are a separate paid service. We can take the project on for ongoing maintenance or hand over everything you need to run it yourself.

tech.question: What technologies do you work with?
tech.answer: A modern stack chosen for the task — we pick technology to fit the product, not the other way around, so it stays fast and scalable. Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind. Backend: Python, Golang. Mobile: Flutter, React Native. AI and automation: AI/LLM integrations, n8n and building pipelines of AI agents. Not just websites — we build process automation and AI-agent pipelines.

rights.question: Who owns the rights to the code and design?
rights.answer: Everything we build for your project belongs to you — on completion you get full access to the code and assets with no lock-in to us. By default we leave a small, unobtrusive credit in the footer, but we'll remove it if you'd like.

remote.question: Do you work remotely?
remote.answer: We work remotely with clients worldwide. We're based in Kazakhstan and deliver projects across the CIS and abroad — for example, Exchange Bridge and xaid.ai are international products. We communicate via messengers and online meetings — wherever is convenient for you.
